items.title: 美中貿易談判新進展！格里爾：部分商品已達成協議、下週一公布更多細節
items.title_en: New Developments in US-China Trade Talks! Greer: Some Products Have Reached an Agreement, More Details to Be Released Next Monday
paras: 美國貿易代表格里爾（Jamieson Greer）週五（25日）表示，美國與中國已就兩國可進行貿易的部分商品達成協議，讓這些商品可享有更優惠的貿易條件，顯示全球兩大經濟體的談判取得最新進展。
根據《CNBC》報導，格里爾表示：「我們實際上已經與中方就其中一些事項達成協議。」他所指的商品包括美國農產品、醫療器材，以及被認為不具敏感性的中國消費品。
格里爾表示，川普政府計畫於下週一公布過去數周雙方談判取得的「更多細節」。他說，目標是劃定部分貿易領域，使其未來可不受關稅措施或更廣泛貿易爭端的影響。
兩國希望部分商品能以「更優惠的條件」進行貿易，若任一方加徵新關稅，這些商品也可能被排除在外。
格里爾並未具體說明協議涵蓋哪些商品、這些商品的關稅可能如何調整，以及新條件何時生效。
他表示，在新的美中「貿易委員會」（Board of Trade）機制下進行的談判，聚焦於「純粹的貿易議題」，而非美國針對先進科技所實施的國家安全限制。
格里爾表示：「所有涉及國家安全的出口管制，我們都不會納入談判。」
川普與習近平5月在北京會面後，宣布成立「貿易委員會」，負責管理兩國在非敏感性商品上的貿易。企業一直等待更多細節，以了解在這項新架構下，哪些貿易類別將被排除在外，並適用較低關稅。
paras_en: U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said on Friday (the 25th) that the United States and China have reached an agreement on a number of products that can be traded between the two countries, allowing those items to enjoy more favorable trade conditions and indicating the latest progress in negotiations between the world’s two largest economies.

According to CNBC, Greer said, “We have actually reached agreements with the Chinese side on some of the items.” The products he referred to include U.S. agricultural goods, medical equipment, and Chinese consumer products that are considered non‑sensitive.

Greer said the Trump administration plans to announce “more details” next Monday about the progress made in the past few weeks of negotiations. He explained that the goal is to delineate certain trade sectors so that they can be insulated from tariff measures or broader trade disputes in the future.
Both countries hope that some products can be traded under “more favorable conditions,” and if either side imposes new tariffs, those products could be excluded from the tariffs.
Greer did not specify which products are covered by the agreement, how the tariffs on those products might be adjusted, or when the new conditions would take effect.

He said that negotiations under the new U.S.-China “Board of Trade” mechanism focus on “purely trade issues,” rather than the national‑security restrictions the United States has imposed on advanced technology.
Greer added, “All export controls that involve national security will not be part of the negotiations.”

After President Trump and President Xi met in Beijing in May, they announced the creation of a “Trade Committee” to manage trade in non‑sensitive goods between the two nations. Companies have been waiting for more details to understand which categories of trade will be excluded under this new framework and will qualify for lower tariffs.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉油價回落促使債券拋售暫歇  主要指數小幅走高
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Rise Slightly as Falling Oil Prices Pause Bond Selling
paras: 美股主要指數周五（25日）小幅上漲，油價漲勢失去動能，以及全球公債殖利率升至數十年來最高水準後，債券市場在遭遇拋售後趨於穩定。與此同時，美中雙方已同意將貿易休戰延長兩個月。
截稿前，標普500指數上漲0.3%，那斯達克綜合指數上漲0.4%。道瓊工業平均指數上漲190點或0.3%，費半上漲0.85%，台積電ADR上漲0.37%。
美國10年期公債殖利率下滑2個基點至5.18%，回吐過去兩個交易日逾20個基點的升幅。
油價下跌也提振市場情緒，市場樂觀認為荷姆茲海峽可能重新開放。伊朗外交部長阿拉格齊（Abbas Araghchi）已提出，如果華府接受伊朗提出的條件，伊朗將重新開放荷姆茲海峽，並在7天內重啟與美國的核談判。
根據《路透》周四（24日）報導，美伊談判代表正探索分階段協議，以重新開放荷姆茲海峽（Strait of Hormuz）。
在能源成本高漲推升通膨壓力、並支撐進一步緊縮貨幣政策前景之際，油價波動可能仍是市場的關鍵驅動因素。
利率交換市場目前已完全反映聯準會未來一年再升息3次、每次升息1碼（25個基點）的預期。這項前景可能持續抑制市場風險偏好，並讓公債殖利率在一段時間內維持高檔。
根據CME FedWatch工具，聯準會基金期貨交易顯示，市場認為聯準會10月升息的機率約為66%。
債券市場的波動也持續。美國10年期公債殖利率周四升至2007年以來最高水準，30年期公債殖利率則觸及2004年以來最高水準。兩者最新分別小幅上升至5.183%和5.478%。
本週殖利率攀升主要受到聯準會理事巴爾（Michael Barr）的鷹派言論、伊朗戰爭導致能源價格持續居高不下，以及一份強勁的採購經理人指數（PMI）報告推動。
追蹤10年期美國公債殖利率的30年期固定房貸利率升至7.45%，創2024年以來最高水準，隨著美國期中選舉臨近，消費者借貸成本似乎也將進一步上升。
摩根士丹利經濟學家Heather Berger在給客戶的報告中寫道：「即使在過去幾天市場變動之前，從2024年年中一路到2026年初，信用卡年利率（APR）和汽車貸款利率的下降趨勢就已經停滯，而房貸利率也重新加速上升。」
她補充：「我們預期這些壓力將抑制支出，主要體現在商品消費方面，這也是我們預期明年實質消費成長將放緩40個基點的原因之一。」
與此同時，交易員也在關注中國國家主席習近平本週訪美的相關進展。美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）本週稍早表示，美中雙方已同意將貿易休戰延長兩個月。

paras_en: U.S. equity indices edged higher on Friday (the 25th), as oil price gains lost momentum and global sovereign‑bond yields rose to their highest levels in decades, stabilising the bond market after a bout of selling. At the same time, the United States and China have agreed to extend their trade truce by two months.
At the time of writing, the S&P 500 was up 0.3%, the Nasdaq Composite rose 0.4%, the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 190 points or 0.3%, the FTSE 100 climbed 0.85%, and TSMC ADR advanced 0.37%.
The yield on the U.S. 10‑year Treasury fell two basis points to 5.18%, erasing more than 20 basis points of gains recorded over the previous two trading sessions.

The drop in oil prices also lifted market sentiment, with optimism that the Strait of Hormuz could be reopened. Iran’s foreign minister Abbas Araghchi said that if Washington accepts Iran’s conditions, Tehran will reopen the strait and restart nuclear talks with the United States within seven days.
According to Reuters on Thursday (the 24th), U.S. and Iranian negotiators are exploring a phased agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
With higher energy costs feeding inflation pressures and underpinning expectations of further monetary tightening, oil‑price volatility is likely to remain a key market driver.

The interest‑rate swap market now fully reflects expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise rates three more times over the next year, each hike of one quarter‑point (25 basis points). This outlook could keep risk appetite subdued and keep Treasury yields elevated for some time.
FedWatch data from CME shows that futures on Fed funds imply a roughly 66% probability of a rate hike in October.

Bond‑market volatility persisted. The U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield hit its highest level since 2007 on Thursday, while the 30‑year yield reached its highest since 2004, with the two now sitting at about 5.183% and 5.478% respectively.

The recent rise in yields was driven mainly by hawkish comments from Fed Governor Michael Barr, ongoing high energy prices due to the Iran conflict, and a strong Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) report.

The 30‑year fixed‑rate mortgage, which tracks the 10‑year Treasury, climbed to 7.45%, the highest since 2024, and as the U.S. mid‑term elections approach, consumer borrowing costs appear set to rise further.

Morgan Stanley economist Heather Berger wrote in a client note: “Even before the market moves of the past few days, the downward trend in credit‑card APRs and auto‑loan rates that had been in place since mid‑2024 had already stalled, and mortgage rates were accelerating upward again.”
She added: “We expect these pressures to curb spending, especially on goods, which is one reason we forecast real consumer‑spending growth to slow by 40 basis points next year.”

Meanwhile, traders are watching developments related to Chinese President Xi Jinping’s visit to the United States this week. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said earlier in the week that the United States and China have agreed to extend their trade truce by two months.

items.title: 特斯拉近月Optimus人形機器人產量提升10倍
items.title_en: Tesla Boosts Optimus Humanoid Robot Production Tenfold in Recent Months
paras: 知情人士透露，近幾個月特斯拉(TSLA-US) Optimus人形機器人產量提升約10倍，但特斯拉仍難以實現穩定規模化量產。產線面臨機器人精密手部組件、自動化設備、供應鏈受限等多重難題。
據《The Information》報導，兩名項目消息人士說，特斯拉上月每周可生產數百台Optimus；第二季小批量試產階段，周產量僅幾十台。
特斯拉管理層向員工表示，目標在年底建成自動化連續產線，實現周產量超過1,000台。不過，該目標距離其遠期周產2萬台的規劃仍有很大差距。
特斯拉執行長馬斯克多次將Optimus稱作旗下最重要產品，稱這款人形機器人未來可承擔各類工作，從工廠生產、資料中心運維，到烹飪、打掃等日常家務。
特斯拉當前主要收入來自電動車銷售，但馬斯克認為Optimus將推動特斯拉進一步轉型為人工智慧企業。
Optimus項目時間表已多次調整。今年1月，馬斯克在世界經濟論壇上表示，特斯拉有望2027年底對外銷售Optimus；4月他又提到預計年中展示新一代Optimus，但該時間節點過後並未舉辦相關演示。
馬斯克在7月財報電話會上坦言，製造Optimus「是一個非常複雜的難題」，擴產挑戰巨大，當時他稱Optimus量產「很快就會啟動」。
知情人士表示，加州弗里蒙特工廠下線的OptimusV3版本，並非面向客戶的最終商用機型，特斯拉仍在持續調試產品。商用版需要滿足更高耐用性與可靠性標準，才會對外投放。
V3版本重量更輕，搭載更多鏡頭，外觀比前代更接近人類形態。
目前產出的機器人大多留作內部測試、模型訓練與數據採集，部分部署在加州帕洛阿爾托特斯拉辦公場所。
在特斯拉工廠內，機器人僅在管控嚴格的區域使用，動作與任務全程受嚴密監控，僅執行預設特定任務，並非通用智慧機器人，也非遠程遙控設備。
paras_en: Insiders say Tesla (TSLA-US) has increased Optimus humanoid robot output by roughly ten times over the past few months, but the company still struggles to achieve stable, large‑scale production. The assembly line faces multiple hurdles, including precise hand components, automation equipment, and supply‑chain constraints.

According to a report by The Information, two project sources said Tesla was able to produce several hundred Optimus units per week last month; during the small‑batch pilot phase in Q2, weekly output was only a few dozen units.

Tesla’s management told employees that the goal is to have an automated continuous production line up and running by year‑end, delivering over 1,000 units per week. However, this target remains far short of the longer‑term plan to reach 20,000 units weekly.

CEO Elon Musk has repeatedly called Optimus the company’s most important product, saying the humanoid robot could eventually handle a wide range of tasks—from factory work and data‑center operations to cooking, cleaning and other household chores.
Tesla’s current revenue is driven mainly by electric‑vehicle sales, but Musk believes Optimus will help push the company further toward becoming an artificial‑intelligence enterprise.

The Optimus timeline has been revised repeatedly. In January, Musk told the World Economic Forum that Tesla hoped to begin external sales of Optimus by the end of 2027; in April he said a new generation would be showcased mid‑year, but no such demo has taken place since.

During the July earnings call, Musk admitted that building Optimus “is a very complex problem” and that scaling up production is a huge challenge, though he claimed mass production would “kick off very soon.”

Sources say the Optimus V3 units rolling off the Fremont, California factory are not the final commercial model for customers; Tesla is still fine‑tuning the product. The commercial version must meet higher durability and reliability standards before it can be released externally.
The V3 version is lighter, equipped with more cameras, and its appearance more closely resembles a human compared with previous generations.
Most of the robots produced are kept for internal testing, model training and data collection, with some deployed at Tesla’s Palo Alto office in California.

Within Tesla’s factories, the robots operate only in tightly controlled zones, with their movements and tasks continuously monitored. They perform predefined specific tasks and are neither general‑purpose AI robots nor remotely controlled devices.

items.title: Meta推1299美元新VR眼鏡！輕蘋果Vision Pro「6倍」、配備AI擬真視訊與觸控打字功能
items.title_en: Meta Unveils $1,299 New VR Glasses! Light Apple Vision Pro “Six‑Times” Lighter, Featuring AI‑Powered Realistic Video and Touch‑Typing
paras: Meta(META-US) 近日推出售價1299美元的新款虛擬實境（VR）眼鏡，在價格與重量上均低於蘋果(AAPL-US) 的Vision Pro，並藉由將主要運算元件移至外接裝置，大幅改變VR頭戴裝置的設計，同時朝讓旗下頭戴裝置事業獲利的方向邁進。
根據《彭博》報導，這款產品名為Meta VR Glasses，最大特色是將處理器、散熱風扇、電池等運算元件從頭戴裝置本體移出，改集中在一個可夾在使用者口袋上或放置於桌面的外接盒中。
Meta過去的產品均將這些元件整合在頭戴裝置內，蘋果Vision Pro則僅將電池置於外接電池組。
Meta VR Glasses在功能上與Vision Pro及Meta既有Quest系列有不少相似之處，包括沉浸式影片播放、辦公室應用程式、作為Mac或PC外接螢幕、網頁瀏覽、遊戲、視訊會議及語音助理等。
值得注意的是，由於大幅減少頭戴端的硬體配置，Meta VR Glasses重量約100公克，約只有蘋果Vision Pro的六分之一、Meta Quest 3S的五分之一。
實際體驗時，這項輕量化設計也讓裝置能長時間佩戴，示範內容包括觀看NBA沉浸式賽事精華、操作Meta重新設計的作業系統，以及透過電腦進行工作。
Meta技術長Andrew Bosworth在接受訪問時表示，公司「對蘋果有一點感激之情」。他指出，許多娛樂業合作夥伴最初是因為Vision Pro才開始對沉浸式運算產生興趣，並認為蘋果讓業界得以「探索分離式架構」，進而啟發Meta採用外接運算盒的設計。
Bosworth表示：「我認為，在其中一些方面，他們（蘋果）確實是我們的先驅，也替我們完成了最艱難的工作。」不過，他也指出，兩款產品其餘部分並沒有太大的可比性，尤其是在價格與重量方面。
Bosworth進一步表示：「我們都知道，他們（蘋果）在這方面沒有達到預期，因為那款裝置根本無法長時間佩戴。它並不像眼鏡，你戴著它看起來很滑稽。」
除重量外，兩款產品在價格方面也存在明顯差異。Meta VR Glasses售價1299美元，約為Vision Pro 3699美元的三分之一，但仍超過Meta Quest 3的599美元兩倍。
Meta VR Glasses單次充電可使用3小時，略高於Vision Pro，最長續航時間則達Quest 3的兩倍。裝置也可以一直連接電源使用。
在顯示規格方面，Meta VR Glasses則不及Vision Pro，每眼解析度約為2.5K，而蘋果產品為4K。不過實際使用時，文字與圖像仍相當清晰，兩者差異並不特別明顯。
此外，Meta VR Glasses採用高通(QCOM-US) 最新的Snapdragon Reality Elite處理器；Vision Pro則採用雙晶片配置，其中包括M5處理器。
Meta VR Glasses另一項主要新功能，是採用全新擬真視訊會議模式，結合全息技術與人工智慧（AI），建立使用者的虛擬影像。在產品展示中，虛擬人物與真人外觀幾乎一致，相較Meta過去在VR環境中使用的虛擬化身已有明顯變化。這項功能也將加入Meta的Ray-Ban眼鏡產品，並支援顯示功能。
Bosworth及其他Meta高層也表示，隨著這款新頭戴裝置推出，公司的商業模式正在改變。Meta過去原本預期，能透過應用程式商店以及虛擬商品所帶來的獲利，來彌補Quest硬體產品的虧損。
但如今，Meta認為1299美元的定價已讓VR Glasses朝單台裝置不再虧損的方向發展。公司表示，目標是在未來幾年讓VR成為具獲利能力的生態系。
Bosworth指出，Meta旗下穿戴式運算部門Reality Labs如今已走過長期投入與建置能力的階段，開始能以更有效率的方式推進相關業務。
此外，Meta VR Glasses也加入觸控打字功能。眼鏡可將虛擬鍵盤與觸控板投影到桌面上，提供類似電腦的操作方式，與過去Quest系列及Vision Pro採用的空中虛擬鍵盤不同。Meta示範時的打字體驗接近在iPad上輸入，使用者能夠快速完成文字輸入。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Meta (META-US) recently launched a new virtual reality (VR) headset priced at $1,299, which is cheaper and lighter than Apple’s (AAPL-US) Vision Pro. By moving the main computing components to an external device, Meta has dramatically altered the design of VR headsets and is moving its headset business toward profitability.

According to Bloomberg, the product is called Meta VR Glasses and its biggest feature is that the processor, cooling fan, battery and other computing parts are taken out of the headset and placed in an external box that can be clipped to the user’s pocket or set on a desk.
Meta’s previous products integrated those components inside the headset, while Apple’s Vision Pro only moves the battery to an external pack.

Meta VR Glasses share many functions with Vision Pro and Meta’s existing Quest line, including immersive video playback, office apps, serving as an external monitor for Mac or PC, web browsing, gaming, video conferencing and voice assistant capabilities.

Notably, because the hardware on the headset itself is greatly reduced, Meta VR Glasses weigh about 100 grams – roughly one‑sixth the weight of Apple’s Vision Pro and one‑fifth the weight of the Meta Quest 3S.

In hands‑on demos, the lightweight design also allowed the device to be worn for extended periods, showcasing NBA immersive highlights, Meta’s redesigned operating system, and computer‑based work tasks.

Meta CTO Andrew Bosworth said in an interview that the company is “a little grateful to Apple.” He noted that many entertainment partners first became interested in immersive computing because of Vision Pro, and that Apple helped the industry “explore a dis‑aggregated architecture,” which inspired Meta’s external compute box design.

Bosworth added, “In some ways they (Apple) were indeed our pioneers and did the hardest work for us.” However, he also said the two products are not comparable in most other respects, especially price and weight.
Bosworth further remarked, “We all know they (Apple) missed the mark here because that device simply can’t be worn for long periods. It’s not like glasses; you look ridiculous wearing it.”
Beyond weight, the price gap is stark. Meta VR Glasses cost $1,299, about one‑third of Vision Pro’s $3,699 price, but still roughly twice the $599 price of the Meta Quest 3.

A single charge gives Meta VR Glasses about three hours of use, slightly more than Vision Pro, and up to twice the longest battery life of the Quest 3. The device can also remain plugged in for continuous use.

In display specs, Meta VR Glasses fall short of Vision Pro, offering roughly 2.5K resolution per eye versus Vision Pro’s 4K. Nevertheless, text and images appear clear in practice, and the difference is not especially noticeable.
The glasses are powered by Qualcomm’s (QCOM-US) latest Snapdragon Reality Elite processor, while Vision Pro uses a dual‑chip setup that includes an M5 processor.

A major new feature of Meta VR Glasses is a realistic video‑conference mode that blends holography with artificial intelligence to create a virtual avatar that looks almost identical to the real user, a big leap from Meta’s previous VR avatars. This capability will also be added to Meta’s Ray‑Ban glasses and support display functions.

Bosworth and other Meta executives said the launch of this new headset is shifting the company’s business model. Meta had originally expected to offset Quest hardware losses through app store revenue and virtual goods sales.
Now Meta believes the $1,299 price point puts VR Glasses on a path toward unit‑level profitability. The company aims to make VR a profit‑generating ecosystem within a few years.
Bosworth noted that Meta’s wearable computing division, Reality Labs, has moved past the long‑term investment and capability‑building phase and can now advance its business more efficiently.

Meta VR Glasses also add a touch‑typing feature. The glasses can project a virtual keyboard and touchpad onto a desk, offering a computer‑like interaction that differs from the air‑based virtual keyboards used by previous Quest models and Vision Pro. In demos, typing felt similar to typing on an iPad, allowing rapid text entry.

items.title: IMF：今年全球AI投資規模可能突破2兆美元
items.title_en: IMF: Global AI Investment Could Exceed $2 Trillion This Year
paras: 國際貨幣基金（IMF）發布最新年度報告，引述外部估計指出，今年由私人部門主導的全球人工智慧（AI）投資規模可能突破2兆美元，成為近年來帶動經濟成長最強勁動力之一。
IMF指出，與AI相關的科技投資，估計帶動美國2025年國內生產毛額（GDP）增速提高0.5個百分點，而美國近年生產率增速加快，某程度上亦反映出AI應用早期正面影響。
不過，IMF同時提出警告，AI投資熱潮背後潛藏隱憂。隨著相關基建及項目規模持續擴大，部分高成本投資越來越依賴債務融資。
一旦未來回報未能達到預期，恐會引發資產估值顯著調整、財富縮水及企業裁員等連鎖效應。
paras_en: The International Monetary Fund (IMF) released its latest annual report, citing external estimates that this year private‑sector‑driven global artificial intelligence (AI) investment could surpass $2 trillion, making it one of the strongest drivers of economic growth in recent years.

The IMF notes that AI‑related technology investment is estimated to boost U.S. GDP growth by 0.5 percentage points in 2025, and the recent acceleration in U.S. productivity growth partly reflects the early positive impact of AI applications.

However, the IMF also warns of hidden risks behind the AI investment boom. As related infrastructure and project scales continue to expand, some high‑cost investments are becoming increasingly reliant on debt financing.
If future returns fall short of expectations, it could trigger a cascade of effects such as significant asset‑valuation adjustments, wealth erosion, and corporate layoffs.

items.title: 法國擬召集G7商討釋出戰略石油儲備
items.title_en: France Plans to Convene G7 to Discuss Releasing Strategic Oil Reserves
paras: 法國總統馬克宏24日（周四）晚接受兩家法國電視台聯合採訪時說，法國擬召集七國集團（G7）成員國開會商討釋出戰略石油儲備，以穩定國際油價。
近期美國和歐洲多國柴油價格均創下新高。馬克宏說，G7成員國可研究如何通過相互協調方式向市場釋放戰略石油儲備，從而降低油價。
馬克宏說，伊朗局勢是全球油價飆升的主要原因，法國將致力於推動中東恢復穩定。
此外，烏克蘭戰爭對油價也有影響，法國就此呼籲雙方停止攻打彼此能源目標。
paras_en: French President Emmanuel Macron said on Thursday evening in a joint interview with two French TV stations that France intends to convene a meeting of the Group of Seven (G7) member countries to discuss releasing strategic oil reserves in order to stabilize international oil prices.

Recently diesel prices in the United States and many European countries have reached new highs. Macron said G7 members could study how to coordinate the release of strategic oil reserves into the market to bring down oil prices.
Macron said the situation in Iran is the main driver of the global oil price surge, and France will work to promote stability in the Middle East.
He also noted that the war in Ukraine affects oil prices, and France called on both sides to cease attacks on each other's energy targets.

items.title: OpenAI傳將推500美元ChatGPT「Pro Max」方案！主打最快Work與Codex、或接Cerebras算力
items.title_en: OpenAI Rumored to Launch $500 ChatGPT “Pro Max” Plan, Highlighting Fastest Work and Codex, Possibly Powered by Cerebras
paras: OpenAI傳出可能推出月費500美元的高階ChatGPT訂閱方案「Pro Max」，但目前尚未獲得官方確認。
科技資訊追蹤帳號TestingCatalog 週四（24日）報導指出，OpenAI正籌備推出「Pro Max」方案，月費可能設定為500美元，並可能採用Cerebras(CBRS-US) 基礎設施提供支援。
若最終推出，這項方案將成為OpenAI針對高階功能及大量運算需求收取更高費用的另一種方式。
根據TestingCatalog描述，Pro Max與現有Pro方案的主要差異，在於增加「Fastest Work and Codex」功能，同時使用額度也可能進一步提高。
不過，目前相關報導並未說明「最快工作速度」具體能提升多少，也未交代Codex的存取方式，以及Cerebras是否最終會為Pro Max提供算力支援。
TestingCatalog將這項傳聞與「長時任務」情境連結，亦即ChatGPT需要持續一段較長時間執行操作，而非僅處理單次提問。
不過，目前OpenAI官方定價頁面列出的ChatGPT方案包括Free、Go、Plus、Pro、Business及Enterprise共6種，尚未出現Pro Max選項。
TestingCatalog指出，相關資訊可能在9月29日於舊金山舉行的OpenAI DevDay 2026期間揭曉，但這項說法目前僅是該帳號的推測。
OpenAI發布的官方活動公告中，目前並未提及Pro Max方案。
paras_en: OpenAI is rumored to be preparing a premium ChatGPT subscription tier called “Pro Max” that could cost $500 per month, though the company has not confirmed this yet.

The tech‑news account TestingCatalog reported on Thursday (the 24th) that OpenAI is planning to roll out the Pro Max tier, with a monthly price possibly set at $500 and potentially supported by Cerebras (CBRS‑US) infrastructure.
If launched, this tier would represent another way for OpenAI to charge higher fees for advanced features and heavy computational workloads.

According to TestingCatalog, the main difference between Pro Max and the existing Pro tier is the addition of “Fastest Work and Codex” capabilities, and the usage limits may also be increased further.
However, the report does not specify how much faster the “fastest work” would be, how Codex access would be provided, or whether Cerebras will ultimately supply the compute power for Pro Max.
TestingCatalog ties the rumor to a “long‑running task” scenario, where ChatGPT needs to execute operations continuously for an extended period rather than handling a single query.
At present, OpenAI’s official pricing page lists six ChatGPT plans—Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise—and does not show a Pro Max option.
TestingCatalog suggests that more details could be revealed on September 29 at OpenAI DevDay 2026 in San Francisco, but this is only the account’s speculation at this time.
The official event announcement from OpenAI does not mention a Pro Max plan.

items.title: 荷蘭首相遊說美國　別再限制ASML對中國出口
paras: 荷蘭首相羅布·耶滕正在直接向美國總統川普交涉，希望阻止華盛頓進一步收緊對晶片設備造商ASML的出口限制。
據《彭博》報導，耶滕24日（周四）表示，他已經多次與川普以及美國國會議員討論《硬體技術管制多邊協調法案》（MATCH），並強調保護半導體產業的重要性。
「我非常有信心，我們最終能夠達成一項對各方都可行的協議。」耶滕說。
爭議的核心，是美國是否會進一步擴大對中國獲取先進晶片製造設備的限制。
目前美國國會正在推動的《MATCH法案》，可能進一步限制美國盟友向中國出口先進晶片製造設備。如果相關措施落實，所有ASML浸潤式深紫外曝光機（immersion DUV）對華銷售都將受到影響。
這意味著美國對華晶片設備限制可能進一步從最先進極紫外曝光機（EUV），向更多DUV設備延伸。
ASML是全球唯一能夠生產EUV曝光機的企業，也是歐洲市值最高的公司之一。其EUV設備從未獲准出口中國，荷蘭政府也已經對部分先進DUV設備實施出口限制。
耶滕認為，荷蘭已經對ASML實施嚴格出口管制，在繼續保護敏感技術的同時，也需要考慮本國半導體產業的利益。
他表示，保護荷蘭晶片產業「不僅符合我國利益，也符合美國以及更廣泛利益」，同時強調相關限制需要保持平衡。
對ASML而言，中國仍然是一個重要市場。今年第二季，中國佔ASML系統銷售淨額14%，較第一季19%有所下降。
因此，《MATCH法案》不只是美荷之間關於出口管制尺度的討論，也牽動ASML在中國市場能夠銷售哪些設備。

items.title: 台中銀行相挺王冠閎！亞運200公尺蝶式頂尖對決 勇奪金牌續寫歷史新猷
items.title_en: Taichung Bank Backs Crown Hung! Asian Games 200m Butterfly Showdown Yields Gold, Continuing Historic Achievements
paras: 2026年愛知．名古屋亞洲運動會泳池畔再度傳來令全台沸騰的狂喜捷報！由台中銀行長期贊助支持的「台灣蝶王」王冠閎，於今(25)日迎戰其招牌主項「男子200公尺蝶式」決賽。王冠閎再度展現國際頂尖的划手節奏與驚人爆發力，最終以1:55.05力壓群雄、順利完賽，並成功奪下金牌！這不僅再次向國際泳壇證明了台灣體育菁英的世界級實力，也為其運動生涯再添一筆輝煌篇章。作為最有力支持者的台中銀行，在賽後第一時間致上最熱烈的掌聲與祝賀。
200公尺蝶式身為王冠閎的招牌主項，在每一次的比賽中，每一次的躍入水中都是對自我的極限挑戰。面對亞洲運動會的高張力競爭，王冠閎挺住壓力、奮戰到最後一刻的運動家精神，感動了無數守在電視機前的大眾。台中銀行表示，運動員在場上追求卓越的每一秒，背後都是無數汗水與淚水的累積；王冠閎在賽道上展現的堅韌意志力，正是台灣的驕傲。
台中銀行指出，培育國際級運動菁英如同經營優質企業，除需長時間的資源挹注，更仰賴「無論風雨、始終陪伴」的信任。台中銀行早已將「體育社會責任」列為核心ESG指標，並落實「資源扎根基層」與「助攻國際成長」的雙軌策略。不以一時的勝負論英雄，而是成為選手最穩健、最溫暖的後盾，正是台中銀行引領體育永續向上的標竿典範。
隨著亞運高強度賽事的洗禮，王冠閎再度用實力與汗水為台灣泳壇寫下動人故事。台中銀行承諾，未來將持續扮演台灣運動員們最堅不可摧的基石，投入資源扶植多元體育發展，伴隨更多台灣優秀菁英征戰國際舞台，讓世界看見台灣永不放棄的體育硬實力！
paras_en: In the swimming venue of the 2026 Aichi‑Nagoya Asian Games, Taiwan’s “Butterfly King” Crown Hung, long‑time sponsor of Taichung Bank, took on his signature event, the men’s 200‑metre butterfly final, on the 25th. Crown Hung again displayed world‑class rhythm and explosive power, finishing in 1:55.05 to outpace the field and claim the gold medal. This not only re‑affirms Taiwan’s elite status on the international swimming stage but also adds another brilliant chapter to his athletic career. Taichung Bank, his staunchest supporter, offered the loudest applause and congratulations immediately after the race.

The 200‑metre butterfly is Crown Hung’s hallmark event, and each dive into the water tests his personal limits. Facing the high‑pressure competition of the Asian Games, he held his composure and fought to the very end, moving countless viewers watching at home. Taichung Bank noted that every second an athlete strives for excellence is backed by countless drops of sweat and tears; Crown Hung’s resilient will on the racecourse is a source of pride for Taiwan.

Taichung Bank pointed out that nurturing international‑level sports talent is akin to running a quality enterprise: it requires long‑term resource investment and a trust of “standing by through any weather.” The bank has already made “sports social responsibility” a core ESG metric, implementing a dual‑track strategy of “ground‑level resource rooting” and “supporting international growth.” Rather than judging heroes by a single win or loss, it aims to be the most stable and warm‑hearted backing for athletes, setting a benchmark for sustainable sports development.

After the intense Asian Games competition, Crown Hung once again wrote a moving story for Taiwanese swimming with his strength and hard work. Taichung Bank pledges to remain the unshakable foundation for Taiwan’s athletes, investing resources to foster diverse sports development and accompany more outstanding Taiwanese elites onto the international stage, letting the world see Taiwan’s relentless sporting prowess.

items.title: 輸歐鋼品配額管理措施調整 鋼鐵公會：全力配合並協助爭取更多配額
items.title_en: Adjustment of EU Steel Export Quota Management Measures; Steel Association: Fully Cooperating and Assisting in Securing More Quotas
paras: 經濟部敲定金屬塗層鋼板出口歐盟管理措施調整，鋼鐵公會表示，將全力配合落實，一方面協助業者向歐盟爭取更多配額，一方面堅定恪遵法規、公平、公正原則，持續扮演政府與鋼鐵產業間溝通橋樑的角色，共同穩定我國鋼品銷歐秩序。
針對近期外界關切我國金屬塗層鋼板輸歐（輸歐鋼品第4A類別）管理措施中「自由申請配額」之審查程序與分配機制，鋼鐵公會24日出席經濟部邀集產業界召開的研商出口歐盟「4A類鋼品管理措施」事宜會議。
經過5小時的研商會議，產官雙方就配額機制與管理占比所達成的共識與優化方向，包括「自由申請配額」占比調整為10%、核配原則及程序維持現有作法、總額平均分三次申請等，鋼鐵公會表示，將持續全力配合及落實經濟部政策與實務運作管理。
鋼鐵公會也再次聲明，受經濟部國際貿易署委託辦理「輸往歐盟鋼鐵產品簽發放行前原產地證明書及加工證明書業務」，恪遵經濟部與業者討論後的配額管理規定。
鋼鐵公會指出，就「自由申請配額」的審查、計算、分配、登錄階段詳實說明，並再次強調依據經濟部公告「輸歐盟特定463項鋼品配額管理規定」，落實資格、合約要件審查，再依合格總申請量的比例公平計算、分配後確實登錄，秉持公平、公正原則，恪守法遵。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs has finalized adjustments to the management measures for exporting metal‑coated steel sheets to the EU. The Steel Association said it will fully cooperate in implementation, help companies lobby the EU for additional quotas, strictly adhere to regulations and the principles of fairness and justice, and continue to serve as a communication bridge between the government and the steel industry to stabilize Taiwan’s steel exports to Europe.

In response to recent public concerns about the review procedures and allocation mechanism for the “free‑application quota” under the management measures for Taiwan’s metal‑coated steel sheet exports to the EU (Category 4A steel products), the Steel Association attended a meeting convened by the Ministry of Economic Affairs on the 24th to discuss the EU “Category 4A steel product management measures.”

After a five‑hour deliberation, the public and private sides reached consensus and identified optimization directions for the quota mechanism and its share, including adjusting the “free‑application quota” proportion to 10%, keeping the existing approval principles and procedures, and dividing the total quota into three equal application rounds. The Steel Association said it will continue to fully cooperate with and implement the Ministry’s policies and operational management.

The Steel Association also reiterated that, commissioned by the International Trade Department of the Ministry of Economic Affairs, it handles the issuance of pre‑export certificates of origin and processing certificates for steel products shipped to the EU, and will strictly follow the quota management rules discussed with the Ministry and industry players.

The Steel Association explained in detail the review, calculation, allocation, and registration stages for the “free‑application quota,” emphasizing that, in accordance with the Ministry’s announcement of the “Specific 463‑item Steel Product Quota Management Regulations for Export to the EU,” it will enforce eligibility and contract‑requirement checks, then fairly calculate and allocate based on the proportion of qualified total applications, and finally register the results, upholding fairness, justice, and compliance.

items.title: 8月外銷訂單突破千億美元、川習會登場、台股市值衝5.3兆美元登全球第四 本周大事回顧
items.title_en: August Export Orders Surpass $100 Billion, Trump‑Xi Summit Held, Taiwan Stock Market Cap Hits $5.3 T, Ranking Fourth Globally – Weekly Highlights
paras: 經濟部周二(22日)公布8月外銷訂單連19紅，單月達1029.6億美元，首度突破千億美元；川習會周四(24日)登場，科技重量級人物包括黃仁勳、庫克等皆出席；台股總市值於周三(23日)衝上5.3兆美元，躍居全球第四，以下為本週大事回顧：

〈外銷訂單〉連19紅！8月首度飆破千億美元年增71.4% 美國訂單年增近9成 

受惠AI、高效能運算及雲端服務等需求持續極速擴張，經濟部周二(22日)公布8月外銷訂單統計，單月接單金額豪取1029.6億美元，不僅繼7月連18紅後順利寫下「連續19個月正成長」紀錄，更是台灣歷年來「單月接單首度突破千億美元大關」，年增率高達71.4%，大幅刷新歷史新高紀錄，主要來自電子和資訊通信產品年增83.9%到100.5%，並以美國為最大訂單來源，8月接單421.3億美元，年增飆近 9 成。

川習會白宮國宴科技大咖雲集！黃仁勳、庫克、蘇姿丰同桌 中方無企業家出席 

美國總統川普周四(24日)在白宮設國宴款待中國國家主席習近平，華爾街與矽谷重量級人物齊聚，凸顯美國科技與金融界的影響力。相較之下，中國代表團則無中國企業主參與，凸顯雙方對這次峰會的期待可能有落差。

台股總市值5.3兆美元超車印度躍全球第4 神山單日貢獻逾1兆元 

台股周三(23日)開高，雖呈高檔震盪，但在權值股領軍走揚下，終場仍上漲 357.12 點，以 48,157.29 點作收，再度改寫歷史新高紀錄，台灣資本市場的世界排名也出現歷史性突破，最新總市值衝上 5.3 兆美元，首度超越印度，躋身全球第 4 大股票市場。而最大的功臣莫過於護國神山台積電，單日就貢獻了超過新台幣 1 兆元的市值增幅。

〈台泥拓展東歐市場〉擬以272億元企業價值 併購烏克蘭第二大水泥公司 

台泥(1101-TW)周三(23日)召開重大訊息記者會，臨時董事會通過授權集團旗下荷蘭子公司TCC Group EMEA Holdings B.V.，以不超過7.5億歐元(約新台幣272億元)的企業價值，收購烏克蘭水泥建材公司Ivano-Frankivskcement(IFCEM)等公司100%股權，進一步將歐洲水泥版圖由南歐、西歐延伸至東歐市場。

〈工資審議〉正式突破3萬大關261萬人受惠！最低工資明年月薪30900元時薪205元

paras_en: On Tuesday (the 22nd), the Ministry of Economic Affairs reported that August export orders continued a 19‑month streak of growth, reaching $102.96 billion – the first time monthly orders have broken the $100 billion mark. The Trump‑Xi summit took place on Thursday (the 24th), with tech heavyweights such as Jensen Huang and Tim Cook in attendance. Taiwan’s total stock‑market capitalization rose on Wednesday (the 23rd) to $5.3 trillion, propelling it to the world’s fourth‑largest market. Below is a review of the week’s major events:

Export orders: 19 consecutive months of growth! August’s orders surged past $100 billion, up 71.4% year‑on‑year, with U.S. orders jumping nearly 90%. Driven by booming demand for AI, high‑performance computing and cloud services, the Ministry of Economic Affairs announced on Tuesday (the 22nd) that August export orders totaled $102.96 billion. This continued a streak of 19 straight months of growth after July’s 18‑month run and marked the first time a single month’s orders have exceeded $100 billion in Taiwan’s history. The year‑on‑year increase hit 71.4%, a new record, led by electronics and ICT products that grew 83.9% to 100.5%, with the United States remaining the biggest buyer at $42.13 billion – up almost 90% year‑on‑year.

Trump‑Xi summit draws a tech‑heavy White House banquet: Jensen Huang, Tim Cook, and Cher Wang share a table; no Chinese entrepreneurs attend. U.S. President Donald Trump hosted Chinese President Xi Jinping at a White House state dinner on Thursday (the 24th). Prominent figures from Wall Street and Silicon Valley gathered, highlighting the influence of America’s tech and finance sectors. In contrast, the Chinese delegation had no business leaders present, suggesting differing expectations for the summit.

Taiwan stock market cap reaches $5.3 trillion, overtaking India to become the world’s fourth‑largest. The market opened higher on Wednesday (the 23rd) and, despite trading in a high‑range swing, closed up 357.12 points at 48,157.29, setting a new all‑time high. The total market value climbed to $5.3 trillion, surpassing India for the first time and securing the fourth‑largest stock market globally. The biggest contributor was “national guardian” TSMC, which alone added more than NT$1 trillion to market cap in a single day.

Taiwan Cement expands into Eastern Europe, planning a €750 million (≈NT$27.2 billion) acquisition of Ukraine’s second‑largest cement firm. Taiwan Cement (1101‑TW) held a major news conference on Wednesday (the 23rd). Its board authorized the Dutch subsidiary TCC Group EMEA Holdings B.V. to acquire 100% of Ivano‑Frankivsk Cement (IFCEM) and related assets for up to €750 million (about NT$27.2 billion), extending the company’s European footprint from Southern and Western Europe into the Eastern European market.

Minimum‑wage review breaks the NT$30,000 barrier, benefiting 2.61 million workers. The minimum‑wage council released its decision on Thursday (the 24th) after extensive deliberation among labor, business, academia and government representatives. Effective Jan 1, 2027, the monthly minimum wage will rise from NT$29,500 to NT$30,900 (a 4.745% increase), and the hourly rate will go from NT$196 to NT$205. The Labor Ministry will submit the proposal to the Executive Yuan for approval. If approved, this will be the 11th consecutive annual increase since 2016, pushing monthly wages past the NT$30,000 mark and is expected to benefit roughly 2.6116 million workers.

Yang Ming: Hummus Strait “situation is quite severe,” Q4 off‑season only sees modest correction. During its earnings call on Tuesday (the 22nd), container carrier Yang Ming (2609‑TW) said that although cargo volumes will ease gradually in the fourth‑quarter off‑season, the lack of consensus on navigation and management rights in the Hummus Strait remains “quite severe.” Combined with port‑congestion issues, the supply‑demand balance stays relatively stable, and the off‑season is expected to bring only a modest correction.

items.title: 「搶配額」大戰落幕！經部落槌：輸歐鋼品總額分3次開放、自由配額減半
items.title_en: "Quota Battle" Ends! Ministry of Economic Affairs Strikes: EU Steel Export Quota Split into Three Rounds, Free Quota Halved
paras: 對近期鋼鐵業者高度關注的我國金屬塗層鋼板（輸歐鋼品第4A類別）出口歐盟管理措施，經濟部昨（24）日緊急邀集代表性鋼鐵業者、貿易商及鋼鐵公會等各方代表，展開長達5小時的跨部會與產業深度研商。經濟部今（25）日正式對外宣布，雙方已達成重大共識，決定將「自由申請配額」占比由原本的20%調降至10%，且總額將平均分三次開放申請，有效避免開開放即被一搶而空的亂象，全力維護我國鋼鐵外銷秩序。

因應歐盟關稅防衛 經濟部跨部會共識敲定

經濟部說明，歐盟自2019年起對進口鋼鐵實施關稅配額防衛措施，並給予台灣特定的國家配額。為維持鋼品輸歐秩序，政府與鋼鐵公會及業界共同研擬出配額機制，將國家配額劃分為「出口實績」與「自由申請配額」兩大類。若業界無特別共識，先前預設自由配額占比為20%。
隨著歐盟鋼鐵防衛措施於今（2026）年6月底屆期，歐盟自7月1日起繼續以關稅配額方式管制鋼品輸入，並新增金屬塗層鋼板的國家配額。為協助國內業者穩健拓展歐盟市場，經濟部比照先前機制公告相關規範，並續由鋼鐵公會辦理受理、審查與分配作業。

審查機制透明化 配額改分三次申請避免秒殺

鋼鐵公會於會中強調，針對4A類別的「自由申請配額」，公會始終秉持公平公正原則，嚴格落實資格審查與合約規範，並依據合格總申請量的比例公開計算與登錄分配，確保各家業者權益。
為了解決業者反映「剛開放申請配額就被搶光」的痛點，會中經充分溝通後達成兩項關鍵調整：
配額比例調降： 金屬塗層鋼板的「自由申請配額」占比由20%調降至10%，擴大實績業者的穩定配額。
分階段開放申請： 自由配額總額將採取平均分三次申請的方式發放，防範短時間內配額耗盡。
經濟部強調，政府高度重視鋼鐵業者的出口利益，未來將因應國際經貿情勢變化，持續與業界保持密切溝通，並滾動式檢討各類輸歐鋼品的分配機制，協助台灣鋼鐵產業在國際市場立於不敗之地。
paras_en: The Ministry of Economic Affairs held an emergency five‑hour inter‑agency and industry round‑table yesterday (the 24th) to discuss Taiwan’s metal‑coated steel sheet (Category 4A steel exports to the EU), which has drawn intense attention from the steel sector. The ministry announced today (the 25th) that a major consensus has been reached: the share of “free‑application quota” will be cut from the original 20% to 10%, and the total amount will be released in three equal batches, preventing the chaos of the quota being snapped up instantly and fully safeguarding Taiwan’s steel export order.

The ministry explained that the EU has applied anti‑dumping tariff‑quota safeguards on imported steel since 2019 and granted Taiwan a specific national quota. To maintain orderly steel exports to the EU, the government, together with the steel association and industry, devised a quota mechanism that divides the national quota into “export‑performance quota” and “free‑application quota.” In the absence of a specific industry agreement, the free quota was previously set at 20%.

As the EU’s steel defence measures expire at the end of June 2026, the EU will continue to regulate steel imports via tariff‑quota from July 1 and has added a national quota for metal‑coated steel sheets. To help domestic firms steadily expand into the EU market, the Ministry of Economic Affairs announced the relevant rules based on the previous mechanism and will continue to have the Steel Association handle applications, reviews and allocations.

The Steel Association emphasized during the meeting that for the 4A “free‑application quota,” it will always uphold fairness and impartiality, strictly enforce eligibility checks and contract standards, and publicly calculate and record allocations based on the proportion of qualified total applications, ensuring the rights of all firms.
To address industry complaints that “the quota is snatched up as soon as it opens,” the meeting, after thorough discussion, agreed on two key adjustments:
Quota share reduction: the “free‑application quota” for metal‑coated steel sheets will be lowered from 20% to 10%, expanding stable allocations for firms with proven export performance.
Staged application: the total free quota will be distributed in three equal rounds, preventing the quota from being exhausted in a short period.

The ministry stressed that the government places great importance on the export interests of steel companies and will, in response to changing international trade conditions, maintain close communication with the industry and continuously review the allocation mechanisms for all EU‑bound steel products, helping Taiwan’s steel sector remain competitive in the global market.

items.title_en: Hot Stock: PCB Breaks the Ghost Story! Taiwan-Japan Supply Chain Ignites, 009828 Gains Over 7% This Week, Returns to Issue Price
paras: 日本股市在結束三天假期後於 24 日恢復交易，吸引資金顯著回補；同時，台股 CCL 族群擺脫先前「降級鬼故事」陰霾，激勵整體 PCB 類股近期連袂上揚。在台日兩地供應鏈齊揚的帶動下，中信台日韓 PCB(009828-TW)展現強勁反彈力道，24 日股價順利站回 10 元發行價，終場上漲 1.73% 收在 10.02 元，單周累計漲幅達 7.28%。整體交投表現持續增溫，反映市場資金關注重心再度強勢回歸。
009828於9月初掛牌，隨即遭遇市場利空，多處於破發狀況，但本周展開強勁反彈，主要歸功於台日兩地 AI 供應鏈的共振效應，日股方面，受惠AI伺服器與高效能運算(HPC)需求，全球IC載板龍頭Ibiden(揖斐電)盤中一度暴漲逾15%，強勢領軍日經指數補漲行情。台股雖呈高檔震盪，但AI硬體升級概念股維持強勁動能，載板與銅箔基板(CCL)族群逆勢上揚，其中聯茂更是亮燈漲停。
法人指出，近期PCB個股逆勢上揚，反映資金正由純AI晶片概念擴散至整體AI硬體供應鏈(如ABF載板、PCB及伺服器設備)。009828聚焦台、日、韓三地的PCB產業鏈龍頭，前十大持股涵蓋欣興、Ibiden、台光電、日東電工、臻鼎-KY、金像電、台燿與南電等關鍵企業。
根據TPCA與工研院產科國際所最新研究，全球載板產值預估於2025年達到147.5億美元(年增18.5%)，2026年更將在AI伺服器、高速交換器與先進封裝需求帶動下，進一步成長至195.1億美元(年增32.3%)，長線成長趨勢明確。
中信台日韓PCB ETF經理人葉松炫表示，過去PCB產業景氣循環較容易受到PC與智慧型手機需求影響，但隨著AI伺服器逐漸成為產業新的成長引擎，市場結構正出現明顯轉變。由於AI伺服器所需PCB層數、材料規格及單機價值均顯著高於傳統伺服器，使產業成長動能不再僅來自出貨量增加，更受惠於產品規格升級所帶來的價值提升。
葉松炫指出，在全球科技巨頭持續擴大AI資料中心投資的帶動下，AI產業發展已從晶片設計與先進製程，進一步延伸至ABF載板、高階PCB及關鍵材料等領域。隨著AI應用持續普及，相關供應鏈可望持續受惠於資料中心建置與硬體升級需求，長線成長潛力值得關注。

paras_en: Japan's stock market resumed trading on the 24th after a three‑day holiday, drawing a notable capital rebound; at the same time, Taiwan's CCL sector shed the previous "downgrade ghost story" gloom, spurring the entire PCB segment to rise together. Driven by a synchronized Taiwan‑Japan supply chain, the China Trust Taiwan‑Japan‑Korea PCB ETF (009828‑TW) showed strong rebound power, with its price on the 24th back at the NT$10 issue price, closing up 1.73% at NT$10.02 and up 7.28% for the week. Overall trading activity kept warming, reflecting a renewed strong focus of market funds.

009828 listed in early September and was immediately hit by market headwinds, trading below its issue price in many places, but this week it staged a robust rebound, mainly thanks to the resonant effect of AI supply chains in both Taiwan and Japan. In Japan, AI server and high‑performance computing (HPC) demand lifted global IC substrate leader Ibiden, whose shares surged more than 15% intraday, leading a Nikkei rebound. Taiwan’s market, though trading in a high‑range range‑bound manner, saw AI hardware upgrade concept stocks maintain strong momentum, with substrate and copper‑foil board (CCL) groups climbing against the trend, and Lianmao hitting a limit‑up.

Institutional investors note that recent PCB stocks are rising against the tide, indicating capital is shifting from pure AI chip concepts to the broader AI hardware supply chain (such as ABF substrates, PCBs and server equipment). 009828 focuses on the PCB industry leaders in Taiwan, Japan and Korea, with its top ten holdings covering key firms like Unimicron, Ibiden, Taiwan‑Optoelectronics, Nitto Denko, Zhen Ding‑KY, Golden Image, Taiwan‑Yao and Nan‑Dian.

According to the latest research by TPCA and the Industrial Technology Research Institute’s International Production Center, global substrate output is projected to reach $14.75 billion in 2025 (up 18.5% YoY) and to grow further to $19.51 billion in 2026 (up 32.3% YoY) driven by AI servers, high‑speed switches and advanced packaging demand, underscoring a clear long‑term growth trend.

China Trust Taiwan‑Japan‑Korea PCB ETF manager Yeh Song‑hsuan said that the PCB industry's business cycle used to be heavily influenced by PC and smartphone demand, but as AI servers become a new growth engine, the market structure is shifting markedly. Because AI servers require PCBs with more layers, higher‑grade materials and a higher unit value than traditional servers, industry growth now stems not only from volume increases but also from value added by upgraded specifications.

Yeh added that, propelled by global tech giants continuously expanding AI data‑center investments, AI development has moved beyond chip design and advanced processes to include ABF substrates, high‑end PCBs and critical materials. As AI applications keep spreading, the related supply chain is expected to benefit continuously from data‑center builds and hardware upgrades, offering notable long‑term growth potential.

items.title: 〈熱門股〉ABF載板供需缺口續擴大 欣興滾量重返千金周漲20%
items.title_en: Hot Stock: ABF Substrate Supply‑Demand Gap Continues to Widen, Unimicron’s Volume Rises, Returns to Thousand‑Dollar Week Up 20%
paras: AI大量需求推升需求，外資高盛報告指出ABF載板供需缺口擴大之中，明、後年缺口尤甚，刺激載板欣興(3037-TW)重獲買盤本周股價重獲買盤擁抱，本周外資買超14324張，股價收在1185元，漲幅20.8%，並站上所有均線。
PCB及IC載板廠欣興最新營收資訊，2026年8月營收以177.46億元創新高，月增9.18%，年增56.26%，欣興2026年1-8月營收1143.35億元，年增34.16%。欣興 2026 年上半年 營收爲 625.56 億元，毛利率 21.61%，年增 8.39 個百分點，上半年稅後純益 193.56 億元，年增 18.23 倍，每股純益達 11.7 元。
欣興因 AI 及 HPC 需求強勁，2026 上半年 AI 產品占比已超過 60%，下半年可望提升到 70%，欣興並且樂觀看待下半年營收持續成長。
欣興本周獲外資買超14324張，股價收在1185元，漲幅20.8%，並站上所有均線，技術線型呈現多頭排列，短線支撐在5日線1093元。
paras_en: AI's massive demand is boosting demand. A foreign‑capital Goldman Sachs report points out that the supply‑demand gap for ABF substrates is widening, with the gap especially large in the next two years, spurring substrate maker Unimicron (3037‑TW) to regain buying interest. This week the stock was embraced by buyers, with foreign investors net buying 14,324 lots, closing at NT$1,185, up 20.8%, and it rose above all moving averages.

PCB and IC substrate manufacturer Unimicron's latest revenue figures show that revenue in August 2026 reached a record high of NT$17.746 billion, up 9.18% month‑on‑month and 56.26% year‑on‑year. Unimicron's revenue for January‑August 2026 was NT$114.335 billion, a 34.16% annual increase. In the first half of 2026, revenue was NT$62.556 billion, gross margin 21.61% (up 8.39 percentage points year‑over‑year). First‑half net profit after tax was NT$19.356 billion, 18.23 times higher year‑over‑year, and earnings per share reached NT$11.7.

Because of strong AI and HPC demand, AI products accounted for more than 60% of Unimicron's sales in the first half of 2026, and are expected to rise to 70% in the second half. Unimicron is also optimistic that revenue will continue to grow in the second half.

This week Unimicron was net bought by foreign investors for 14,324 lots, closing at NT$1,185, up 20.8%, and it rose above all moving averages. The technical chart shows a bullish arrangement, with short‑term support at the 5‑day line of NT$1,093.

items.title: 〈美股早盤〉油價回落促使債券拋售暫歇  主要指數小幅走高
items.title_en: U.S. Stocks Rise Slightly as Falling Oil Prices Pause Bond Selling
paras: 美股主要指數周五（25日）小幅上漲，油價漲勢失去動能，以及全球公債殖利率升至數十年來最高水準後，債券市場在遭遇拋售後趨於穩定。與此同時，美中雙方已同意將貿易休戰延長兩個月。
截稿前，標普500指數上漲0.3%，那斯達克綜合指數上漲0.4%。道瓊工業平均指數上漲190點或0.3%，費半上漲0.85%，台積電ADR上漲0.37%。
美國10年期公債殖利率下滑2個基點至5.18%，回吐過去兩個交易日逾20個基點的升幅。
油價下跌也提振市場情緒，市場樂觀認為荷姆茲海峽可能重新開放。伊朗外交部長阿拉格齊（Abbas Araghchi）已提出，如果華府接受伊朗提出的條件，伊朗將重新開放荷姆茲海峽，並在7天內重啟與美國的核談判。
根據《路透》周四（24日）報導，美伊談判代表正探索分階段協議，以重新開放荷姆茲海峽（Strait of Hormuz）。
在能源成本高漲推升通膨壓力、並支撐進一步緊縮貨幣政策前景之際，油價波動可能仍是市場的關鍵驅動因素。
利率交換市場目前已完全反映聯準會未來一年再升息3次、每次升息1碼（25個基點）的預期。這項前景可能持續抑制市場風險偏好，並讓公債殖利率在一段時間內維持高檔。
根據CME FedWatch工具，聯準會基金期貨交易顯示，市場認為聯準會10月升息的機率約為66%。
債券市場的波動也持續。美國10年期公債殖利率周四升至2007年以來最高水準，30年期公債殖利率則觸及2004年以來最高水準。兩者最新分別小幅上升至5.183%和5.478%。
本週殖利率攀升主要受到聯準會理事巴爾（Michael Barr）的鷹派言論、伊朗戰爭導致能源價格持續居高不下，以及一份強勁的採購經理人指數（PMI）報告推動。
追蹤10年期美國公債殖利率的30年期固定房貸利率升至7.45%，創2024年以來最高水準，隨著美國期中選舉臨近，消費者借貸成本似乎也將進一步上升。
摩根士丹利經濟學家Heather Berger在給客戶的報告中寫道：「即使在過去幾天市場變動之前，從2024年年中一路到2026年初，信用卡年利率（APR）和汽車貸款利率的下降趨勢就已經停滯，而房貸利率也重新加速上升。」
她補充：「我們預期這些壓力將抑制支出，主要體現在商品消費方面，這也是我們預期明年實質消費成長將放緩40個基點的原因之一。」
與此同時，交易員也在關注中國國家主席習近平本週訪美的相關進展。美國財政部長貝森特（Scott Bessent）本週稍早表示，美中雙方已同意將貿易休戰延長兩個月。

paras_en: U.S. equity indices edged higher on Friday (the 25th), as oil price gains lost momentum and global sovereign‑bond yields rose to their highest levels in decades, stabilising the bond market after a bout of selling. At the same time, the United States and China have agreed to extend their trade truce by two months.
At the time of writing, the S&P 500 was up 0.3%, the Nasdaq Composite rose 0.4%, the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained 190 points or 0.3%, the FTSE 100 climbed 0.85%, and TSMC ADR advanced 0.37%.
The yield on the U.S. 10‑year Treasury fell two basis points to 5.18%, erasing more than 20 basis points of gains recorded over the previous two trading sessions.

The drop in oil prices also lifted market sentiment, with optimism that the Strait of Hormuz could be reopened. Iran’s foreign minister Abbas Araghchi said that if Washington accepts Iran’s conditions, Tehran will reopen the strait and restart nuclear talks with the United States within seven days.
According to Reuters on Thursday (the 24th), U.S. and Iranian negotiators are exploring a phased agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz.
With higher energy costs feeding inflation pressures and underpinning expectations of further monetary tightening, oil‑price volatility is likely to remain a key market driver.

The interest‑rate swap market now fully reflects expectations that the Federal Reserve will raise rates three more times over the next year, each hike of one quarter‑point (25 basis points). This outlook could keep risk appetite subdued and keep Treasury yields elevated for some time.
FedWatch data from CME shows that futures on Fed funds imply a roughly 66% probability of a rate hike in October.

Bond‑market volatility persisted. The U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield hit its highest level since 2007 on Thursday, while the 30‑year yield reached its highest since 2004, with the two now sitting at about 5.183% and 5.478% respectively.

The recent rise in yields was driven mainly by hawkish comments from Fed Governor Michael Barr, ongoing high energy prices due to the Iran conflict, and a strong Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) report.

The 30‑year fixed‑rate mortgage, which tracks the 10‑year Treasury, climbed to 7.45%, the highest since 2024, and as the U.S. mid‑term elections approach, consumer borrowing costs appear set to rise further.

Morgan Stanley economist Heather Berger wrote in a client note: “Even before the market moves of the past few days, the downward trend in credit‑card APRs and auto‑loan rates that had been in place since mid‑2024 had already stalled, and mortgage rates were accelerating upward again.”
She added: “We expect these pressures to curb spending, especially on goods, which is one reason we forecast real consumer‑spending growth to slow by 40 basis points next year.”

Meanwhile, traders are watching developments related to Chinese President Xi Jinping’s visit to the United States this week. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said earlier in the week that the United States and China have agreed to extend their trade truce by two months.

items.title: 特斯拉近月Optimus人形機器人產量提升10倍
items.title_en: Tesla Boosts Optimus Humanoid Robot Production Tenfold in Recent Months
paras: 知情人士透露，近幾個月特斯拉(TSLA-US) Optimus人形機器人產量提升約10倍，但特斯拉仍難以實現穩定規模化量產。產線面臨機器人精密手部組件、自動化設備、供應鏈受限等多重難題。
據《The Information》報導，兩名項目消息人士說，特斯拉上月每周可生產數百台Optimus；第二季小批量試產階段，周產量僅幾十台。
特斯拉管理層向員工表示，目標在年底建成自動化連續產線，實現周產量超過1,000台。不過，該目標距離其遠期周產2萬台的規劃仍有很大差距。
特斯拉執行長馬斯克多次將Optimus稱作旗下最重要產品，稱這款人形機器人未來可承擔各類工作，從工廠生產、資料中心運維，到烹飪、打掃等日常家務。
特斯拉當前主要收入來自電動車銷售，但馬斯克認為Optimus將推動特斯拉進一步轉型為人工智慧企業。
Optimus項目時間表已多次調整。今年1月，馬斯克在世界經濟論壇上表示，特斯拉有望2027年底對外銷售Optimus；4月他又提到預計年中展示新一代Optimus，但該時間節點過後並未舉辦相關演示。
馬斯克在7月財報電話會上坦言，製造Optimus「是一個非常複雜的難題」，擴產挑戰巨大，當時他稱Optimus量產「很快就會啟動」。
知情人士表示，加州弗里蒙特工廠下線的OptimusV3版本，並非面向客戶的最終商用機型，特斯拉仍在持續調試產品。商用版需要滿足更高耐用性與可靠性標準，才會對外投放。
V3版本重量更輕，搭載更多鏡頭，外觀比前代更接近人類形態。
目前產出的機器人大多留作內部測試、模型訓練與數據採集，部分部署在加州帕洛阿爾托特斯拉辦公場所。
在特斯拉工廠內，機器人僅在管控嚴格的區域使用，動作與任務全程受嚴密監控，僅執行預設特定任務，並非通用智慧機器人，也非遠程遙控設備。
paras_en: Insiders say Tesla (TSLA-US) has increased Optimus humanoid robot output by roughly ten times over the past few months, but the company still struggles to achieve stable, large‑scale production. The assembly line faces multiple hurdles, including precise hand components, automation equipment, and supply‑chain constraints.

According to a report by The Information, two project sources said Tesla was able to produce several hundred Optimus units per week last month; during the small‑batch pilot phase in Q2, weekly output was only a few dozen units.

Tesla’s management told employees that the goal is to have an automated continuous production line up and running by year‑end, delivering over 1,000 units per week. However, this target remains far short of the longer‑term plan to reach 20,000 units weekly.

CEO Elon Musk has repeatedly called Optimus the company’s most important product, saying the humanoid robot could eventually handle a wide range of tasks—from factory work and data‑center operations to cooking, cleaning and other household chores.
Tesla’s current revenue is driven mainly by electric‑vehicle sales, but Musk believes Optimus will help push the company further toward becoming an artificial‑intelligence enterprise.

The Optimus timeline has been revised repeatedly. In January, Musk told the World Economic Forum that Tesla hoped to begin external sales of Optimus by the end of 2027; in April he said a new generation would be showcased mid‑year, but no such demo has taken place since.

During the July earnings call, Musk admitted that building Optimus “is a very complex problem” and that scaling up production is a huge challenge, though he claimed mass production would “kick off very soon.”

Sources say the Optimus V3 units rolling off the Fremont, California factory are not the final commercial model for customers; Tesla is still fine‑tuning the product. The commercial version must meet higher durability and reliability standards before it can be released externally.
The V3 version is lighter, equipped with more cameras, and its appearance more closely resembles a human compared with previous generations.
Most of the robots produced are kept for internal testing, model training and data collection, with some deployed at Tesla’s Palo Alto office in California.

Within Tesla’s factories, the robots operate only in tightly controlled zones, with their movements and tasks continuously monitored. They perform predefined specific tasks and are neither general‑purpose AI robots nor remotely controlled devices.

items.title: Meta推1299美元新VR眼鏡！輕蘋果Vision Pro「6倍」、配備AI擬真視訊與觸控打字功能
items.title_en: Meta Unveils $1,299 New VR Glasses! Light Apple Vision Pro “Six‑Times” Lighter, Featuring AI‑Powered Realistic Video and Touch‑Typing
paras: Meta(META-US) 近日推出售價1299美元的新款虛擬實境（VR）眼鏡，在價格與重量上均低於蘋果(AAPL-US) 的Vision Pro，並藉由將主要運算元件移至外接裝置，大幅改變VR頭戴裝置的設計，同時朝讓旗下頭戴裝置事業獲利的方向邁進。
根據《彭博》報導，這款產品名為Meta VR Glasses，最大特色是將處理器、散熱風扇、電池等運算元件從頭戴裝置本體移出，改集中在一個可夾在使用者口袋上或放置於桌面的外接盒中。
Meta過去的產品均將這些元件整合在頭戴裝置內，蘋果Vision Pro則僅將電池置於外接電池組。
Meta VR Glasses在功能上與Vision Pro及Meta既有Quest系列有不少相似之處，包括沉浸式影片播放、辦公室應用程式、作為Mac或PC外接螢幕、網頁瀏覽、遊戲、視訊會議及語音助理等。
值得注意的是，由於大幅減少頭戴端的硬體配置，Meta VR Glasses重量約100公克，約只有蘋果Vision Pro的六分之一、Meta Quest 3S的五分之一。
實際體驗時，這項輕量化設計也讓裝置能長時間佩戴，示範內容包括觀看NBA沉浸式賽事精華、操作Meta重新設計的作業系統，以及透過電腦進行工作。
Meta技術長Andrew Bosworth在接受訪問時表示，公司「對蘋果有一點感激之情」。他指出，許多娛樂業合作夥伴最初是因為Vision Pro才開始對沉浸式運算產生興趣，並認為蘋果讓業界得以「探索分離式架構」，進而啟發Meta採用外接運算盒的設計。
Bosworth表示：「我認為，在其中一些方面，他們（蘋果）確實是我們的先驅，也替我們完成了最艱難的工作。」不過，他也指出，兩款產品其餘部分並沒有太大的可比性，尤其是在價格與重量方面。
Bosworth進一步表示：「我們都知道，他們（蘋果）在這方面沒有達到預期，因為那款裝置根本無法長時間佩戴。它並不像眼鏡，你戴著它看起來很滑稽。」
除重量外，兩款產品在價格方面也存在明顯差異。Meta VR Glasses售價1299美元，約為Vision Pro 3699美元的三分之一，但仍超過Meta Quest 3的599美元兩倍。
Meta VR Glasses單次充電可使用3小時，略高於Vision Pro，最長續航時間則達Quest 3的兩倍。裝置也可以一直連接電源使用。
在顯示規格方面，Meta VR Glasses則不及Vision Pro，每眼解析度約為2.5K，而蘋果產品為4K。不過實際使用時，文字與圖像仍相當清晰，兩者差異並不特別明顯。
此外，Meta VR Glasses採用高通(QCOM-US) 最新的Snapdragon Reality Elite處理器；Vision Pro則採用雙晶片配置，其中包括M5處理器。
Meta VR Glasses另一項主要新功能，是採用全新擬真視訊會議模式，結合全息技術與人工智慧（AI），建立使用者的虛擬影像。在產品展示中，虛擬人物與真人外觀幾乎一致，相較Meta過去在VR環境中使用的虛擬化身已有明顯變化。這項功能也將加入Meta的Ray-Ban眼鏡產品，並支援顯示功能。
Bosworth及其他Meta高層也表示，隨著這款新頭戴裝置推出，公司的商業模式正在改變。Meta過去原本預期，能透過應用程式商店以及虛擬商品所帶來的獲利，來彌補Quest硬體產品的虧損。
但如今，Meta認為1299美元的定價已讓VR Glasses朝單台裝置不再虧損的方向發展。公司表示，目標是在未來幾年讓VR成為具獲利能力的生態系。
Bosworth指出，Meta旗下穿戴式運算部門Reality Labs如今已走過長期投入與建置能力的階段，開始能以更有效率的方式推進相關業務。
此外，Meta VR Glasses也加入觸控打字功能。眼鏡可將虛擬鍵盤與觸控板投影到桌面上，提供類似電腦的操作方式，與過去Quest系列及Vision Pro採用的空中虛擬鍵盤不同。Meta示範時的打字體驗接近在iPad上輸入，使用者能夠快速完成文字輸入。
（本文不開放合作夥伴轉載）
paras_en: Meta (META-US) recently launched a new virtual reality (VR) headset priced at $1,299, which is cheaper and lighter than Apple’s (AAPL-US) Vision Pro. By moving the main computing components to an external device, Meta has dramatically altered the design of VR headsets and is moving its headset business toward profitability.

According to Bloomberg, the product is called Meta VR Glasses and its biggest feature is that the processor, cooling fan, battery and other computing parts are taken out of the headset and placed in an external box that can be clipped to the user’s pocket or set on a desk.
Meta’s previous products integrated those components inside the headset, while Apple’s Vision Pro only moves the battery to an external pack.

Meta VR Glasses share many functions with Vision Pro and Meta’s existing Quest line, including immersive video playback, office apps, serving as an external monitor for Mac or PC, web browsing, gaming, video conferencing and voice assistant capabilities.

Notably, because the hardware on the headset itself is greatly reduced, Meta VR Glasses weigh about 100 grams – roughly one‑sixth the weight of Apple’s Vision Pro and one‑fifth the weight of the Meta Quest 3S.

In hands‑on demos, the lightweight design also allowed the device to be worn for extended periods, showcasing NBA immersive highlights, Meta’s redesigned operating system, and computer‑based work tasks.

Meta CTO Andrew Bosworth said in an interview that the company is “a little grateful to Apple.” He noted that many entertainment partners first became interested in immersive computing because of Vision Pro, and that Apple helped the industry “explore a dis‑aggregated architecture,” which inspired Meta’s external compute box design.

Bosworth added, “In some ways they (Apple) were indeed our pioneers and did the hardest work for us.” However, he also said the two products are not comparable in most other respects, especially price and weight.
Bosworth further remarked, “We all know they (Apple) missed the mark here because that device simply can’t be worn for long periods. It’s not like glasses; you look ridiculous wearing it.”
Beyond weight, the price gap is stark. Meta VR Glasses cost $1,299, about one‑third of Vision Pro’s $3,699 price, but still roughly twice the $599 price of the Meta Quest 3.

A single charge gives Meta VR Glasses about three hours of use, slightly more than Vision Pro, and up to twice the longest battery life of the Quest 3. The device can also remain plugged in for continuous use.

In display specs, Meta VR Glasses fall short of Vision Pro, offering roughly 2.5K resolution per eye versus Vision Pro’s 4K. Nevertheless, text and images appear clear in practice, and the difference is not especially noticeable.
The glasses are powered by Qualcomm’s (QCOM-US) latest Snapdragon Reality Elite processor, while Vision Pro uses a dual‑chip setup that includes an M5 processor.

A major new feature of Meta VR Glasses is a realistic video‑conference mode that blends holography with artificial intelligence to create a virtual avatar that looks almost identical to the real user, a big leap from Meta’s previous VR avatars. This capability will also be added to Meta’s Ray‑Ban glasses and support display functions.

Bosworth and other Meta executives said the launch of this new headset is shifting the company’s business model. Meta had originally expected to offset Quest hardware losses through app store revenue and virtual goods sales.
Now Meta believes the $1,299 price point puts VR Glasses on a path toward unit‑level profitability. The company aims to make VR a profit‑generating ecosystem within a few years.
Bosworth noted that Meta’s wearable computing division, Reality Labs, has moved past the long‑term investment and capability‑building phase and can now advance its business more efficiently.

Meta VR Glasses also add a touch‑typing feature. The glasses can project a virtual keyboard and touchpad onto a desk, offering a computer‑like interaction that differs from the air‑based virtual keyboards used by previous Quest models and Vision Pro. In demos, typing felt similar to typing on an iPad, allowing rapid text entry.
This article is not open for partner re‑publication.

items.title: OpenAI傳將推500美元ChatGPT「Pro Max」方案！主打最快Work與Codex、或接Cerebras算力
items.title_en: OpenAI Rumored to Launch $500 ChatGPT “Pro Max” Plan, Highlighting Fastest Work and Codex, Possibly Powered by Cerebras
paras: OpenAI傳出可能推出月費500美元的高階ChatGPT訂閱方案「Pro Max」，但目前尚未獲得官方確認。
科技資訊追蹤帳號TestingCatalog 週四（24日）報導指出，OpenAI正籌備推出「Pro Max」方案，月費可能設定為500美元，並可能採用Cerebras(CBRS-US) 基礎設施提供支援。
若最終推出，這項方案將成為OpenAI針對高階功能及大量運算需求收取更高費用的另一種方式。
根據TestingCatalog描述，Pro Max與現有Pro方案的主要差異，在於增加「Fastest Work and Codex」功能，同時使用額度也可能進一步提高。
不過，目前相關報導並未說明「最快工作速度」具體能提升多少，也未交代Codex的存取方式，以及Cerebras是否最終會為Pro Max提供算力支援。
TestingCatalog將這項傳聞與「長時任務」情境連結，亦即ChatGPT需要持續一段較長時間執行操作，而非僅處理單次提問。
不過，目前OpenAI官方定價頁面列出的ChatGPT方案包括Free、Go、Plus、Pro、Business及Enterprise共6種，尚未出現Pro Max選項。
TestingCatalog指出，相關資訊可能在9月29日於舊金山舉行的OpenAI DevDay 2026期間揭曉，但這項說法目前僅是該帳號的推測。
OpenAI發布的官方活動公告中，目前並未提及Pro Max方案。
paras_en: OpenAI is rumored to be preparing a premium ChatGPT subscription tier called “Pro Max” that could cost $500 per month, though the company has not confirmed this yet.

The tech‑news account TestingCatalog reported on Thursday (the 24th) that OpenAI is planning to roll out the Pro Max tier, with a monthly price possibly set at $500 and potentially supported by Cerebras (CBRS‑US) infrastructure.
If launched, this tier would represent another way for OpenAI to charge higher fees for advanced features and heavy computational workloads.

According to TestingCatalog, the main difference between Pro Max and the existing Pro tier is the addition of “Fastest Work and Codex” capabilities, and the usage limits may also be increased further.
However, the report does not specify how much faster the “fastest work” would be, how Codex access would be provided, or whether Cerebras will ultimately supply the compute power for Pro Max.
TestingCatalog ties the rumor to a “long‑running task” scenario, where ChatGPT needs to execute operations continuously for an extended period rather than handling a single query.
At present, OpenAI’s official pricing page lists six ChatGPT plans—Free, Go, Plus, Pro, Business, and Enterprise—and does not show a Pro Max option.
TestingCatalog suggests that more details could be revealed on September 29 at OpenAI DevDay 2026 in San Francisco, but this is only the account’s speculation at this time.
The official event announcement from OpenAI does not mention a Pro Max plan.

items.title: AI代理掀長期硬體需求！戴爾示警「記憶體」、「HDD」短缺恐延續逾5年
items.title_en: AI Agents Spark Long‑Term Hardware Demand! Dell Warns Memory and HDD Shortages Could Persist Over 5 Years
paras: 人工智慧代理（AI Agent）可能正在改變過去由設備更新與資本支出驅動的硬體循環。戴爾科技副總裁暨營運長Jeff Clarke指出，若AI代理工作負載持續快速成長，記憶體與硬碟（HDD）等關鍵零組件的供應短缺，可能延續超過5年，代表這一輪AI基礎建設需求可能不只是短期硬體補庫，而是更長期的結構性擴張。
Clarke近期與摩根士丹利（Morgan Stanley）會談時表示，AI代理帶來的硬體需求與過去週期明顯不同。過去硬體供應緊張通常維持數個季度，但如果AI工作負載持續增加，供應吃緊可能延續多年，其中記憶體與HDD是目前最值得關注的零組件。
摩根士丹利在會談後重新評估這一輪AI基礎建設週期，認為過去40年間8次硬體景氣循環主要受到設備汰換與資本支出變化影響，但這次週期的關鍵在於AI工作負載是否能持續擴大。

AI代理改變硬體需求邏輯　算力需求可能長期擴張

Clarke認為，過去數十年的伺服器、儲存設備與PC硬體週期，多半受到產品滲透率與設備更新週期推動，需求會隨著企業更新設備的速度起伏，但整體市場規模並未因此出現根本性變化。
疫情期間的PC需求就是一例。當時人機比例一度提高，但隨著社會恢復正常，PC需求也逐步回落，疫情前後的整體市場規模並沒有發生實質改變。
AI代理的需求模式則有所不同。Clarke認為，AI代理正在讓認知產出與人力投入脫鉤，企業不必增加相同比例的人力，就能完成更多工作，生產力甚至可能提升10倍至100倍。
在這種情況下，AI不只是協助員工完成工作的工具，而會成為持續消耗計算資源的生產力工具。隨著更多企業開始進行AI轉型，基礎設施的整體可服務市場（TAM）也將持續擴大。
戴爾預估，到2030年，資料中心算力將新增200吉瓦，ZettaFLOPS算力將成長5倍至830；推理Token的生成量則可能呈現指數級成長。
其中，AI代理執行單位工作的Token需求遠高於基本聊天機器人，Clarke預估，到2030年推理Token生成量可能增加87倍。

AI工作負載分散　雲端與本地部署並非零和

隨著Token需求快速增加，AI工作負載最終會集中於公有雲，還是轉向企業自建基礎設施，也成為市場關注焦點。
Clarke認為，AI代理將採取混合部署模式。企業會根據安全性與成本效益，在公有雲與本地環境之間持續調整推理工作負載的部署位置。
他以戴爾自身使用情況為例，公司會將與內容相關的工作負載放在公有雲，但專有原始碼及遙測資料則不會移出自有基礎設施。
這代表AI工作負載並不存在單一部署路徑，本地基礎設施仍將承接部分持續增加的運算需求。
Clarke並指出，開源權重模型日益普及，也可能進一步推動企業投資本地基礎設施，因為企業可以在自有環境中針對成本對模型輸出進行最佳化。
因此，Token需求大幅增加不一定代表雲端與本地基礎設施形成此消彼長的關係，兩者都可能隨AI工作負載增加而擴張。

伺服器出貨量下降　仍不代表需求轉弱

目前傳統伺服器出貨量年減，但推理Token卻快速增加，兩者看似存在矛盾。
對此，Clarke解釋稱，伺服器效能密度大幅提高，是造成設備出貨量下降的重要因素。戴爾第17、18代伺服器的運算能力，可以取代多達13台第14代傳統伺服器。
因此，短期內即使伺服器出貨量下滑，單台設備的價值與運算承載能力仍持續提升。
隨著資料中心逐步完成以加速運算為核心的架構重整，加上AI代理普及進一步帶動CPU伺服器需求，伺服器出貨量仍可能重新增加。
Clarke甚至指出，如果推理Token在5年內真的成長87倍，傳統伺服器出貨量也可能出現大幅增長。
記憶體需求同樣可能受到AI代理長期帶動。AI代理每執行一項操作，包括保存記憶、產生工作成果等，都會持續產生資料儲存需求；隨著KV 快取大規模應用，儲存容量需求也可能進一步增加。

記憶體、HDD供應緊張　恐成逾5年結構性問題

在宏觀經濟、地緣政治、資料中心過度建設及電力供應等議題之外，Clarke目前最擔心的是供應問題，並以「我們身處夢幻之地」（We're in neverland）形容當前供應環境。
摩根士丹利指出，歷來大宗商品供應週期通常維持2至4個季度，主要受到硬體更新週期以及供應端決策影響。
但Clarke認為，如果市場接受資料中心算力與推理Token持續大幅成長的預期，記憶體與HDD等關鍵零組件就不再只是一般的短期供需週期。
戴爾目前因此以關鍵零組件可能多年持續短缺的情境進行營運規劃，其中記憶體與HDD尤其受到關注。
換句話說，這一輪供應緊張的核心風險不只是短期供給不足，而是AI需求若持續擴大，供應端可能需要多年時間才能追上需求增幅。
Clarke同時表示，戴爾在供應管理方面優於同業，這項優勢目前正轉化為伺服器、儲存設備及PC等多個市場的市占率增長。

供應吃緊改變定價　基礎建設利潤率擴張

關鍵零組件長期供應緊張，也正在改變AI基礎建設產業的定價環境。
摩根士丹利此前曾將伺服器與儲存業務毛利率擴張，部分歸因於「利潤堆疊」，也就是記憶體等零組件成本上升之際，廠商進一步增加利潤空間。
Clarke則提出不同解釋。他承認伺服器與儲存產品的利潤率確實正在擴張，但認為背後存在兩項結構性因素。
首先，當零組件供應有限時，企業會優先將稀缺資源配置給利潤率較高的產品；其次，隨著基礎建設市場規模持續擴大，企業爭奪新增客戶的壓力下降，也不必透過降價來取得客戶。
因此，利潤率提升不完全是短期供需失衡帶來的結果，也反映AI基礎建設需求持續擴張後，產業定價環境正在發生變化。
分析指出，如果AI代理帶來的工作負載增長持續實現，AI基礎建設週期的核心驅動因素就可能從「設備更新」轉向「新增需求」。在此情況下，算力、伺服器與儲存設備的需求可能維持更長時間，而記憶體、HDD等關鍵零組件的供應限制，也可能從短期週期性波動轉變為持續多年的結構性問題。
paras_en: AI agents may be reshaping the hardware cycle that was previously driven by equipment upgrades and capital spending. Dell Technologies Vice President and COO Jeff Clarke said that if AI agent workloads keep growing rapidly, shortages of key components such as memory and hard‑disk drives (HDDs) could last more than five years, meaning this round of AI infrastructure demand may be a longer‑term structural expansion rather than a short‑term hardware restock.

Clarke told Morgan Stanley in a recent meeting that the hardware demand generated by AI agents is markedly different from past cycles. Historically, tight hardware supply usually lasted only a few quarters, but if AI workloads keep rising, supply constraints could extend for years, with memory and HDDs being the components to watch most closely.

After the meeting, Morgan Stanley reassessed this AI infrastructure cycle, noting that the eight hardware cycles over the past 40 years were mainly driven by equipment replacement and cap‑ex shifts, whereas this cycle hinges on whether AI workloads can continue to expand.

AI agents change the logic of hardware demand – compute needs may expand over the long term. Clarke said that server, storage and PC hardware cycles over the past decades were largely driven by product penetration and equipment refresh cycles, with demand ebbing and flowing as enterprises upgraded, but the overall market size did not fundamentally change.

The PC demand surge during the pandemic is an example. Human‑machine ratios rose temporarily, but as society returned to normal, PC demand fell back, and the overall market size before and after the pandemic remained essentially unchanged.

The demand pattern for AI agents is different. Clarke believes AI agents are decoupling cognitive output from labor input, allowing companies to accomplish more work without proportionally increasing staff, potentially boosting productivity by ten‑ to one‑hundred‑fold.

In this scenario, AI is not just a tool that helps employees do their jobs; it becomes a productivity engine that continuously consumes compute resources. As more firms embark on AI transformation, the total addressable market for infrastructure will keep expanding.
Dell estimates that by 2030 data‑center compute capacity will add 200 GW, ZettaFLOPS compute will grow five‑fold to 830, and the generation of inference tokens could see exponential growth.
Among these, the token demand for AI agents executing work units is far higher than that of basic chatbots. Clarke projects that inference token generation could rise 87‑fold by 2030.

AI workload distribution – cloud versus on‑premise – is not a zero‑sum game. As token demand surges, the market is watching whether AI workloads will concentrate in public clouds or shift toward enterprise‑built infrastructure.

Clarke says AI agents will adopt a hybrid deployment model. Companies will continuously adjust the placement of inference workloads between public cloud and on‑premise environments based on security and cost considerations.
He cites Dell’s own practice as an example: the company runs content‑related workloads in the public cloud, while proprietary source code and telemetry data stay on its own infrastructure.
This means AI workloads do not follow a single deployment path; on‑premise infrastructure will still absorb a growing share of compute demand.

Clarke also notes that the growing prevalence of open‑source weight models may further push enterprises to invest in on‑premise infrastructure, as they can optimize model output costs within their own environments.
Thus, a sharp rise in token demand does not necessarily imply a trade‑off between cloud and on‑premise resources; both can expand as AI workloads increase.

Server shipments are falling, but that does not signal weakening demand. Traditional server shipments are declining year‑over‑year, yet inference token volume is rising rapidly, seemingly contradictory.

Clarke explains that the dramatic increase in server performance density is a key factor behind the shipment decline. Dell’s 17th‑ and 18th‑generation servers can deliver the compute power of up to 13 of the 14th‑generation traditional servers.
Therefore, even if server shipments dip in the short term, the value and compute capacity of each unit continue to rise.
As data centers progressively complete architecture overhauls centered on accelerated computing, and AI agent adoption further drives CPU server demand, server shipments may pick up again.
Clarke even suggests that if inference tokens truly grow 87‑fold within five years, traditional server shipments could see a substantial rebound.

Memory demand could also be driven long‑term by AI agents. Every AI agent operation – from storing memory to generating outputs – creates ongoing data storage needs; with large‑scale KV cache use, storage capacity demand may further increase.

Tight supply of memory and HDDs could become a structural issue lasting more than five years. Beyond macro‑economic, geopolitical, over‑building of data centers and power‑supply concerns, Clarke’s biggest worry is supply, describing the current environment as “we’re in neverland.”
Morgan Stanley points out that commodity supply cycles historically last two to four quarters, driven mainly by hardware refresh cycles and supplier decisions.

Clarke argues that if the market accepts the expectation of sustained, large‑scale growth in data‑center compute and inference tokens, memory and HDDs will no longer be subject to ordinary short‑term supply‑demand cycles.
Dell is therefore planning operations around a scenario where key components could remain scarce for years, with particular focus on memory and HDDs.
In other words, the core risk of this supply crunch is not just a short‑term shortage; if AI demand keeps expanding, the supply side may need many years to catch up with the demand surge.
Clarke also says Dell’s supply‑chain management is superior to peers, and this advantage is currently translating into market‑share gains across servers, storage and PCs.
Tight long‑term supply of key components is also reshaping pricing in the AI infrastructure industry.
Morgan Stanley previously noted that server and storage gross margins have expanded, partly due to “profit stacking,” where vendors increase margin as component costs like memory rise.
Clarke offers a different view. He acknowledges that server and storage profit margins are indeed expanding, but attributes this to two structural factors.

First, when component supply is limited, companies prioritize allocating scarce resources to higher‑margin products; second, as the infrastructure market grows, competitive pressure to win new customers eases, reducing the need to cut prices.
Thus, margin expansion is not solely the result of short‑term supply‑demand imbalance; it also reflects a changing pricing environment as AI infrastructure demand continues to grow.

Analysts note that if AI‑agent‑driven workload growth persists, the core driver of the AI infrastructure cycle could shift from “equipment replacement” to “new demand.” In that case, demand for compute, servers and storage may endure longer, and supply constraints on memory, HDDs and other key parts could evolve from short‑term cyclical fluctuations to multi‑year structural issues.

items.title: 馬斯克衝AI算力！Colossus 2擴產進度曝光 年底晶片數量拚破120萬顆
items.title_en: Musk Pushes AI Compute! Colossus 2 Expansion Timeline Revealed, Chip Count to Exceed 1.2 Million by Year‑End
paras: SpaceX(SPCX-US)執行長馬斯克(Elon Musk)周五(25日)凌晨表示，旗下xAI計劃在今年底前，讓在美國曼菲斯興建的人工智慧(AI)運算中心Colossus 2所使用的先進輝達(NVDA-US)晶片數量大幅增加。
馬斯克周五公布了迄今最詳細的Colossus 2擴建時間表，根據他在X平台上的發文，Colossus 2目前配備11萬顆輝達GB200晶片與44萬顆GB300晶片，合計55萬顆GPU。
他表示，另外22萬顆GB300預定下周投入運作，11月再增加22萬顆。若進展順利，12月底前還可能再增加22萬顆GB300，代表總數可達到121萬顆。
整體而言，若11月新增的晶片如期上線，Colossus 2的晶片數量將較目前增加約80%。若12月底前最後一批22萬顆也順利投入運作，則將增至目前的約2.2倍。
馬斯克形容Colossus為「全球最大的AI超級電腦」。Colossus 1最初於2024年建置，用於訓練xAI旗艦AI模型Grok，但這座運算中心後來持續擴大，並開始為其他AI計畫提供運算能力。今年稍早，xAI也開始將該設施的運算能力出租給Anthropic與Alphabet旗下Google(GOOGL-US)。
xAI先前曾表示，計劃在2026年底前，讓曼菲斯設施配備100萬顆GPU。馬斯克並未說明Colossus 2目前是否已具備足夠的現成運算容量與電力，以支撐上述新增晶片。
paras_en: SpaceX (SPCX-US) CEO Elon Musk said early Friday (the 25th) that his xAI project plans to dramatically increase the number of advanced Nvidia (NVDA-US) chips used in the AI compute center Colossus 2, which is being built in Memphis, USA, before the end of the year.

Musk on Friday released the most detailed Colossus 2 expansion schedule to date. According to his post on X, Colossus 2 currently houses 110,000 Nvidia GB200 chips and 440,000 GB300 chips, a total of 550,000 GPUs.

He added that another 220,000 GB300 chips are slated to go live next week, with an additional 220,000 in November. If everything proceeds smoothly, a further 220,000 GB300 chips could be added by the end of December, bringing the total to about 1.21 million chips.

Overall, if the November additions come online as scheduled, Colossus 2’s chip count will be roughly 80% higher than today’s level. If the final batch of 220,000 chips is also operational by the end of December, the total would be about 2.2 times the current count.

Musk described Colossus as “the world’s largest AI supercomputer.” Colossus 1 was initially built in 2024 to train xAI’s flagship model Grok, but the facility has since been expanded and now provides compute power for other AI projects. Earlier this year, xAI began leasing capacity at the site to Anthropic and Google (GOOGL-US), a subsidiary of Alphabet.

xAI previously said it aims to equip the Memphis facility with 1 million GPUs by the end of 2026. Musk did not specify whether Colossus 2 currently has sufficient ready‑made compute capacity and power to support the announced chip additions.

items.title: 黃仁勳再駁AI末日論：模型若無法控制 就該關閉實驗室！
items.title_en: Jensen Huang Rejects AI Doomsday Claims: If a Model Can't Be Controlled, Shut Down the Lab!
paras: 人工智慧 (AI) 企業高層頻頻警告，失控的超級 AI 可能威脅人類，並以產業競爭壓力為由，要求政府協助放慢研發腳步。輝達(NVDA-US)執行長黃仁勳對此提出不同看法，認為開發商若無法控制自己打造的模型，就不應繼續研發，而應直接關閉實驗室。
黃仁勳週三 (23 日) 接受《紐約時報》知名 Podcast 節目《The Ezra Klein Show》專訪時表示，如果 AI 實驗室聲稱無法控制實驗，模型在測試期間可能外洩並危害世界，合理的處理方式就是停止實驗室運作。
「如果他們說，沒有任何方法可以控制實驗，測試 AI 模型時，模型將會外洩並危害世界，那麼我認為答案就是必須關閉這些實驗室。」黃仁勳說。
他以自駕車為例指出，如果工程師無法訓練自駕車，使其符合道路安全標準，企業就不應推出產品。同樣的原則也適用於 AI：企業若認為即將發布的產品不安全，本身便有能力、責任及誘因停止推出。
黃仁勳認為，AI 安全問題的核心在於企業及產品責任。若 AI 實驗室造成重大損害，不僅可能對人類帶來難以承受的代價，企業與股東也可能面臨龐大的民事及刑事責任。
超過 1,300 名 AI 實驗室員工先前聯署表示，各家公司面臨激烈競爭壓力，難以單方面放慢 AI 發展速度。
當節目主持人 Ezra Klein 引述這項說法時，黃仁勳直接予以否定，強調並沒有人向這些公司施壓。
黃仁勳表示，企業及執行長都擁有自主決策權。如果他認為即將推出的產品不安全，完全有能力、權力及責任停止發布，而且也有充分誘因這麼做。
他贊成由第三方進行安全稽核，但不認同 AI 公司以競爭壓力為由，要求放寬反壟斷法或產品責任規範。
黃仁勳表示，這是他首次聽到企業或執行長聲稱，必須減輕反壟斷法及產品責任法的約束，才能放慢自身發展速度。
在他看來，現行網路安全、產品責任及財產損害等法律，同樣適用於 AI 實驗室。業者不能一方面聲稱模型可能失控，另一方面又要求政府降低其法律責任，以便繼續開發。
針對被稱為「AI 教父」的電腦科學家 Geoffrey Hinton 認為，AI 摧毀人類機率可能達 10%，黃仁勳也公開反駁，形容這類說法不負責任。
黃仁勳表示，這項 10% 的機率缺乏科學與研究依據，即使說法出自科學家，也不代表預測本身符合科學標準。他指出，這類缺乏依據的預測會造成傷害。
談到 AI 研發資源配置，黃仁勳表示，輝達約將 20% 的資源投入設計，其餘 80% 用於驗證；目前多數 AI 實驗室的配置則相反，約 80% 投入能力開發，僅有 20% 用於安全驗證。
他主張，AI 必須加速發展才能提高安全性，業者需要取得更多運算資源，並將其投入模型評估及對齊。隨著評估程序變得更加嚴格，開發模型所需的運算量可能增至目前的 10 倍。
黃仁勳認為，改善 AI 安全不需要全球性條約，而是應讓 AI 公司遵守其他產業已適用的責任標準。產品若無法符合安全要求，企業便不應推出。
不過，輝達目前市值達 5.4 兆美元，無論 AI 實驗室將運算資源投入模型能力或安全驗證，都需要採購輝達晶片。若安全評估使運算需求增加 10 倍，輝達同樣能從中受益；相較之下，AI 產業共同放慢發展速度，才可能減少其晶片需求。
paras_en: AI executives have repeatedly warned that uncontrolled super‑AI could threaten humanity, and have urged governments to slow development under the pretext of industry competition pressure. Nvidia (NVDA-US) CEO Jensen Huang offered a different view, saying that if developers cannot control the models they build, they should stop development and shut the lab down.

On Wednesday (the 23rd), Huang told the New York Times’ popular podcast The Ezra Klein Show that if an AI lab claims it cannot control an experiment and the model might leak during testing and endanger the world, the sensible response is to cease the lab’s operations.

"If they say there’s no way to control the experiment and that testing the AI model could cause it to leak and harm the world, then I think the answer is that those labs must be shut down," Huang said.

He used self‑driving cars as an example: if engineers cannot train a self‑driving car to meet road‑safety standards, the company should not launch the product. The same principle applies to AI: if a firm believes a forthcoming product is unsafe, it has both the ability, responsibility and incentive to stop its release.

Huang believes the core of AI safety lies in corporate and product liability. If an AI lab causes major damage, not only could humanity bear unbearable costs, but the company and its shareholders could face huge civil and criminal liabilities.
More than 1,300 AI‑lab employees previously signed a petition saying companies face fierce competitive pressure and cannot unilaterally slow AI development.
When host Ezra Klein cited that petition, Huang flatly denied it, emphasizing that no one is pressuring these companies.

Huang said that companies and CEOs have autonomous decision‑making power. If a CEO thinks a product about to launch is unsafe, he has full ability, authority and responsibility to halt its release, and ample incentive to do so.
He supports third‑party safety audits but rejects AI firms’ claims that competitive pressure justifies loosening antitrust or product‑liability rules.
Huang noted this was the first time he’d heard a company or CEO say they need to ease antitrust and product‑liability constraints in order to slow their own development pace.

In his view, existing cyber‑security, product‑liability and property‑damage laws already apply to AI labs. Companies cannot claim models might get out of control on one hand while asking the government to reduce their legal responsibilities on the other.
Addressing the “godfather of AI” computer scientist Geoffrey Hinton’s claim that AI could destroy humanity with a 10% probability, Huang publicly rebutted it as irresponsible.

Huang said the 10% figure lacks scientific and research basis; even if it comes from a scientist, it doesn’t mean the prediction meets scientific standards. He warned that such unfounded forecasts cause harm.

Discussing AI R&D resource allocation, Huang said Nvidia puts about 20% of its resources into design and the remaining 80% into verification; most AI labs do the opposite, allocating roughly 80% to capability development and only 20% to safety verification.

He argues that AI must accelerate development to improve safety, requiring more compute power for model evaluation and alignment. As evaluation procedures tighten, the compute needed to develop models could rise to ten times current levels.

Huang believes improving AI safety does not require a global treaty; instead, AI firms should be subject to the same responsibility standards already applied in other industries. If a product cannot meet safety requirements, the company should not launch it.

However, Nvidia’s market value now stands at $5.4 trillion, and regardless of whether AI labs devote compute to capability or safety verification, they must purchase Nvidia chips. If safety assessments raise compute demand tenfold, Nvidia would benefit equally; by contrast, a collective slowdown in the AI sector would likely reduce chip demand.

items.title: Oracle大型AI資料中心傳電力延誤Project Jupiter發出不可抗力通知
items.title_en: Oracle Large AI Data Center Faces Power Delay; Project Jupiter Issues Force Majeure Notice
paras: 2026年09月25日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI資料中心建設面臨的電力瓶頸持續浮現。Oracle(ORCL-US)已向Blue Owl Capital(OWL-US)旗下單位發出不可抗力通知，原因涉及美國新墨西哥州大型資料中心Project Jupiter可能延遲取得電力。不過Oracle表示，專案目前仍維持原定進度。
Project Jupiter占地1,400英畝，原訂2028年上線，也是Oracle與OpenAI合作提供AI運算能力的一部分。據報導，該專案已取得180億美元銀行貸款，Blue Owl投入約30億美元股權資金，Oracle則負責相關債務成本。
知情人士表示，依雙方合約，取得場址電力是Oracle的責任。此次發出不可抗力通知並非退出專案，而是若Project Jupiter因電力問題無法如期上線，可延後部分付款時程。Blue Owl也表示，通知不會改變雙方對這項多年期專案的財務承諾。
除了電力取得，Project Jupiter也傳出規畫中的天然氣管線延誤，並面臨用水及空氣品質許可相關法律挑戰。該專案同時屬於星際之門Stargate計畫的一部分，星際之門Stargate計畫由OpenAI、軟銀集團SoftBank Group(9984-JP)及包括Oracle在內的合作夥伴參與，規畫投入5,000億美元建設美國AI基礎設施。
Project Jupiter的進展也凸顯大型AI資料中心建設的限制正從伺服器與資金，進一步延伸至電力與地方基礎設施。隨單一資料中心園區用電規模持續提高，電力取得、天然氣管線及環境許可能否如期完成，正開始直接影響AI算力上線時程。
